gemma-4-26b-a4b-it-ipsupport.title: Gemma 4 26B-A4B IT — IPSupport quants
gemma-4-26b-a4b-it-ipsupport.subtitle: GGUF and MLX builds of Google's 26B MoE with per-expert GPTQ
gemma-4-26b-a4b-it-ipsupport.description:
Quantized builds of Google's Gemma 4 26B-A4B instruction model (128-expert MoE, ~4B active per token).

| Variation | Format | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `gguf/jang-imatrix` | GGUF (llama.cpp, Ollama) | bit map by component role, imatrix; MTP drafter and vision projector included |
| `other/mlx-gptq-jang` | MLX (Apple Silicon) | per-expert GPTQ, attention at 8 bits, experts at 4 bits: 15 GB from 51.6 GB |
| `other/mlx-mtp-drafter-8bit` | MLX | Google's multi-token-prediction drafter for speculative decoding (35.8 -> 52.9 tok/s on a short prompt, base M5) |

Each variation's overview is its Hugging Face model card.

nemotron-3-5-lightning-30b-a3b-ipsupport.description:
MLX builds of NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B (hybrid Mamba-2 / attention / 128-expert MoE).

| Variation | Notes |
|---|---|
| `mlx-jang-gptq-code-lora` | JANG bit map + our GPTQ, with the IPSupport Code tool-calling LoRA merged; 16.7 GB |
| `mlx-jang-gptq-code-lora-mtp` | the same with the multi-token-prediction head kept for self-speculative decoding |
| `mlx-gptq-jang` | JANG + GPTQ, no LoRA: wikitext-2 PPL 5.24 at 4.24 bits/weight (bf16 5.11) |
| `mlx-gptq-3bit` | uniform 3-bit GPTQ: the latency end of the frontier (PPL 6.24), answers degrade markedly |
